adjudication.rationale: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members, the new code sets `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then uses it directly in `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. This allows a client to pass a negative offset (e.g. "-10" => -10) or arbitrarily large offsets. Negative offsets can produce invalid SQL (e.g. `OFFSET -10`) or errors depending on the DB/AR behavior, making this a real correctness/robustness issue introduced by the diff.
